text:
cname
Description
Causes the specified name to be sent as a CNAME response.
Syntax
cname
<
cname
>
cname <cname>
Sends the specified CNAME response
Examples
when
DNS_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
wideip
name
]
ends_with
".com"
}
{
cname
"my.host.org"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
,
GLOBAL_GTM
